Maternal blood gene expression (GEO **GSE59491**) at the first sampling
time point: SVD, Welch t-tests between birth outcomes and a gene-wise
association scan with gestational age at delivery.

Source: `met_classification/GA_genexpr.jl` (its regression loop wrote into
an undefined `RExp`; replaced by `exposure_scan`).

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Random, LinearAlgebra, Distributions, Statistics, StatsBase
using HypothesisTests, Plots
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
df      = read_arrow(datadir("GSE59491", "GSE59491_cov.arrow"));
genexpr = read_arrow(datadir("GSE59491", "GSE59491_genexpr.arrow"));

# no missing data
sum(sum(ismissing.(genexpr[:, i])) for i in 1:size(genexpr, 2)),
sum(sum(ismissing.(df[:, i])) for i in 1:size(df, 2))

df1 = df[df.sp_time .== 1, :]                  # first time point
X_genexpr = rescale(permutedims(Matrix{Float64}(genexpr[:, string.(df1.geo_id)])))
gene_ids = string.(genexpr.ID_REF)
```

SVD (no evident cluster):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
svd_genexpr = svd(X_genexpr)
scatter(svd_genexpr.U[:, 1], svd_genexpr.U[:, 2], label = "")
svd_genexpr.S .^ 2 / sum(svd_genexpr.S .^ 2)
```

Mean difference between birth outcomes (Welch t-test, Bonferroni):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
pvals = zeros(size(X_genexpr, 2))
Threads.@threads for i in 1:size(X_genexpr, 2)
    pvals[i] = pvalue(UnequalVarianceTTest(X_genexpr[df1.birth_out_1 .== 1, i],
                                           X_genexpr[df1.birth_out_1 .== 0, i]))
end
T_genexpr = DataFrame(gene = gene_ids, p_value = pvals, bonferroni = pvals .<= 0.05 / length(pvals))
T_genexpr[T_genexpr.bonferroni, :]
```

Gene-wise regression of gestational age:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
ewas_results = exposure_scan(Float64.(df1.gestage), X_genexpr; names = gene_ids)
scatter(df1.gestage, X_genexpr[:, gene_ids .== "30850_at"], label = "30850_at")
histogram(X_genexpr[:, 1])
```
